reviews.body:
The model refresh addresses a real upcoming retirement, but the two Vercel AI SDK v4 examples retain an incompatible sampling default. Consider addressing the request-compatibility issue noted inline before landing the migration.

AI-assisted review.
The code looks good; no qualifying findings. Verdict: correct.

review_comments.body: Addressed in 1296a21ca: both v4 examples explicitly set temperature: 1. Independent offline tests through the locked generateText/streamText public entries captured temperature 0 before this commit and 1 at this head, with both paths completing against JSON/SSE fixtures. Both send API 2023-06-01, where Anthropic documents default sampling as accepted; the blanket removal applies to API 2026-10-21. No live provider calls were made.
